create.label: Create new
create.desc: Brabo creates the repository on the provider and runs the Gitflow bootstrap.

adopt.label: Adopt existing
adopt.desc: Points the project to a repository that already exists. Nothing is created, and nothing is changed without your approval.

container.label: Container
container.desc: Brabo manages the folder, inside the volume shared with the engine. It's the default, and requires nothing from you.

mounted.label: Mounted folder
mounted.desc: The code lives in a folder of YOURS, inside the installation's projects base (BRABO_PROJECTS_BASE). It's created when Infra starts the container.

runner.label: Local runner
runner.desc: The code lives in a folder of YOURS, with no bind-mount at all. You run the brabo-runner CLI on your machine, and it confirms the path when it connects.

local.label: Local
local.desc: Local git repository, no external provider

adopt.note: Nothing is created and nothing is changed now. The next step shows a plan of what the bootstrap would do to this repository — and you decide whether to apply it or adopt it as-is.

create.githubPrivateWarning: On GitHub's free plan, private repositories don't support branch protection. The project works and the branches are created, but the "Protect branches" step will fail, and GitHub won't block direct pushes to main, qa, and dev — Brabo's own merge lock still applies, GitHub's doesn't.

workspace.hintMounted: absolute path, as it appears INSIDE the container
workspace.hintRunner: absolute path, as it appears on YOUR machine
workspace.mountedWarning: The folder needs to sit inside the projects base the operator configured (BRABO_PROJECTS_BASE) — the only folder of your machine the api and engine containers can see. It doesn't need to exist yet: it's created when Infra starts the project's container.
